author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-Seven! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

By popular demand- ARGATORIA. Miss old Warhammer style armies? Loved Warmaster but you weren't born until after the Millennium? Want to edge some bases Goblin Green? This is the game for you. Let's check it out!

Check out the rulebook and models in  HERE: https://www.spellcrow.com/argatoria-c-76.html
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 057 - ARGATORIA   by Spellcrow
